meta.name: Trinkets
meta.description: A grieving teen finds an unexpected connection with two classmates at her new high school after they all land in the same Shoplifters Anonymous group.

videos.title: Mirror Faces
videos.overview: Adjusting to a new home and high school after her mom's death leads Elodie back into her comfort zone -- and into a competition with Tabitha and Moe.

videos.title: Paper Tiger
videos.overview: An invitation to a club may provide a cure-all for Elodie's homesickness, Tabitha's growing disenchantment with her boyfriend and Moe's empty house.

videos.title: P*ssy Palace
videos.overview: A community service day at school presents an unexpected chance for Elodie, Tabitha and Moe to bond as they check out some intriguing merchandise.

videos.title: Happy F**king Birthday
videos.overview: Amid growing doubts about her boyfriend, Tabitha puts on a happy face for her 17th birthday. Meanwhile, Moe encourages Elodie to spread her wings.

videos.title: Big Mistake
videos.overview: Elodie, Tabitha and Moe band together in order to retrieve a treasured keepsake, but their mischief quickly takes a turn into real trouble.

videos.title: Rearview Mirror
videos.overview: As Elodie hits the mall to deal with her grief, Moe questions her relationship with Noah, and Tabitha gets fed up with everyone's expectations.

videos.title: Truth Serum
videos.overview: A house party gives Elodie, Tabitha and Moe an opportunity to cut loose, but a shocking confession threatens to derail their friendship.

videos.title: Monday I'm in Love
videos.overview: With the afternoon off from school, Elodie reconnects with her crush, Tabitha goes shopping with a friend, and Moe spends time with Noah.

videos.title: Night Market
videos.overview: When a five-finger discount at a school event results in potentially serious consequences for Elodie, she turns to Tabitha and Moe for help.

videos.title: The Great Escape
videos.overview: The trio deal with demands, disappointments and decisions as Brady puts the squeeze on Tabitha, Moe lashes out, and Elodie receives a tempting offer.

videos.title: Supernova
videos.overview: With Moe and Tabitha dodging questions about her whereabouts, Elodie experiences the highs and lows of life on the road with the flighty Sabine.

videos.title: Last Night of Freedom
videos.overview: Anxious about returning home, Elodie instead enjoys some sticky-fingered bonding with her best friends. Meanwhile, Moe's impetuousness causes concern.

videos.title: Disconnected
videos.overview: Moe's relationship with Tabitha wobbles when a secret is accidentally revealed, and Elodie looks for an after-school activity to placate her dad.

videos.title: Ghouls Just Wanna Have Fun
videos.overview: Being grounded doesn't stop Elodie from trying to bump into her crush at a Halloween party or asking Moe and Tabitha along to be her costumed backup.

videos.title: Works in Progress
videos.overview: Moe struggles to be the kind of girlfriend Noah needs, Tabitha feels stung after being racially profiled, and Elodie takes a chance with Jillian.

videos.title: Ocean's 11th Grade
videos.overview: As Elodie marks a milestone in her personal growth, Moe contends with a blackmail scheme during a robotics competition.

videos.title: Same Time Last Year
videos.overview: An impromptu Thanksgiving gathering serves up a surprise guest, a secret romance and a host of bittersweet memories for Elodie, Tabitha and Moe.

videos.title: Black Friday
videos.overview: Elodie's musical debut sets the stage for drama as Moe and Tabitha reckon with mutual family dysfunction and their own fraught friendship.

videos.title: Aren't You Gonna Say Something?
videos.overview: Fallout from the stolen test plagues Moe, a meetup with Sabine robs Elodie of something precious, and a chance meeting with an ex opens Tabitha's eyes.

videos.title: We Belong
videos.overview: In a risky gambit that they hope will heal past hurts and help them move forward together, the trio plans one last epic crime.

meta.slogan: Friendship is priceless. Everything else you can steal.
